name: steam_turbine_heat_loss
title: Steam turbine with heat loss (example 5.10)
summary: 1.5 kg/s of steam enters a turbine that gives up 8.5 kW of heat. Inlet and outlet pressure, temperature or quality, velocity and elevation are known. The first law for a steady open system gives the power. Teaching example 5.10, ULiège THD, 2017-2018.
